fullPassage: Living things are not confined to the familiar temperate realm of land, water, and sunlight inhabited by plants and plant-eating animals. They can be found in the darkest depths of the ocean, in hot volcanic mud, in pools beneath the frozen surface of the Antarctic, and buried kilometers deep in the Earth's crust. The creatures that live in these extreme environments are generally unfamiliar, not only because they are inaccessible, but also because they are mostly microscopic. In more homely habitats, too, most organisms are too small for us to see without special equipment: they tend to go unnoticed, unless they cause a disease or rot the timbers of our houses. Studies of bacteria have helped us become familiar with those species of industrial importance, such as those used in breaking down waste materials. Yet microorganisms make up most of the total mass of living matter on our planet. Only recently, through new methods of molecular analysis and specifically through the analysis of DNA sequences, have we begun to get a picture of life on Earth that is not grossly distorted by our biased perspective as large animals living on dry land.

❌ ① macroscopic
❌ ② telescopic
❌ ③ endoscopic
✅ ④ microscopic
❌ ③ microscopic: 현미경적으로 작은
❌ ① macroscopic: 육안으로 보이는
❌ ② telescopic: 망원경의
✅ ④ endoscopic: 내시경의
det.tip: micro(작은) + scopic(보는) = microscopic(극히 작은)

questions.passage: Living things are not confined to the familiar temperate realm of land, water, and sunlight inhabited by plants and plant-eating animals. They can be found in the darkest depths of the ocean, in hot volcanic mud, in pools beneath the frozen surface of the Antarctic, and buried kilometers deep in the Earth's crust. The creatures that live in these extreme environments are generally unfamiliar, because they are mostly __________. (microscope) Studies of bacteria have helped us become familiar with those species of industrial importance, such as those used in breaking down waste materials.
questions.stem: 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 (   ) 쓰시오. (1단어 (1단어) (영어로))

det.analysis: microscope(명사) → microscopic(형용사). 보어 자리이므로 형용사
det.tip: microscope(현미경, 명사) → microscopic(현미경적인/극히 작은, 형용사)

questions.passage: Yet microorganisms make up most of the total mass of living matter on our planet. Only recently have we begun to get a picture of life on Earth that is not grossly distorted by our biased __________ as large animals. (perceive)
questions.stem: 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 (   ) 쓰시오. (1단어 (1단어) (영어로))

det.analysis: perceive(동사) → perspective(명사). biased(형용사) 뒤 명사 필요. perception도 가능하나 원문은 perspective
det.tip: perceive(인식하다) → perception(인식) / perspective(관점, 시각)

questions.passage: Living things are not confined to the familiar temperate realm of land, water, and sunlight inhabited by plants and plant-eating animals. They can be found in the darkest depths of the ocean, in hot volcanic mud, in pools beneath the frozen surface of the Antarctic, and buried kilometers deep in the Earth's crust. The creatures that live in these extreme environments are generally unfamiliar, not only because ____ are inaccessible, but also because they are mostly microscopic. In more homely habitats, too, most organisms are too small for us to see without special equipment: they tend to go unnoticed, unless they cause a disease or rot the timbers of our houses. Studies of bacteria have helped us become familiar with those species of industrial importance, such as those used in breaking down waste materials. Yet microorganisms make up most of the total mass of living matter on our planet. Only recently, through new methods of molecular analysis and specifically through the analysis of DNA sequences, have we begun to get a picture of life on Earth that is not grossly distorted by our biased perspective as large animals living on dry land.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?
ch: they are extremely dangerous to humans
they live only in tropical regions
they have been recently discovered by scientists

det.korean: 미생물이 우리에게 낯선 이유: they are inaccessible(접근할 수 없기 때문에)
det.analysis:
❌ ① they are extremely dangerous: 위험성은 언급 없음
✅ ② they are inaccessible: 접근 불가 — 원문 일치 ← 정답
❌ ③ they live only in tropical regions: 특정 지역 한정 — 원문과 다름
❌ ④ recently discovered: 최근 발견 — 원문과 다름
det.tip: not only ~ but also: 접근 불가 + 극히 작음 → 낯선 이유

questions.passage: Living things are not confined to the familiar temperate realm of land, water, and sunlight inhabited by plants and plant-eating animals. They can be found in the darkest depths of the ocean, in hot volcanic mud, in pools beneath the frozen surface of the Antarctic, and buried kilometers deep in the Earth's crust. The creatures that live in these extreme environments are generally unfamiliar, not only because they are inaccessible, but also because they are mostly microscopic. In more homely habitats, too, most organisms are too small for us to see without special equipment: they tend to go unnoticed, unless they cause a disease or rot the timbers of our houses. Studies of bacteria have helped us become familiar with those species of industrial importance, such as those used in breaking down waste materials. Yet microorganisms make up most of the total mass of living matter on our planet. Only recently, through new methods of molecular analysis and specifically through the analysis of DNA sequences, have we begun to get a picture of ____ on Earth that is not grossly distorted by our biased perspective as large animals living on dry land.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?
ch: our biased perspective as large animals
bacteria play no role in industry
DNA analysis has limited scientific value

det.korean: 우리의 생명에 대한 이해는 큰 동물로서의 편향된 관점(our biased perspective as large animals)에서 나왔다.
det.analysis:
❌ ① large animals dominate: 지배 언급 없음
✅ ② our biased perspective as large animals: 원문 "our biased perspective as large animals living on dry land" ← 정답
❌ ③ bacteria play no role: bacteria는 중요한 역할 함
❌ ④ DNA analysis has limited value: 오히려 DNA분석이 중요한 발견을 가능케 함
det.tip: biased perspective: 편향된 시각. large animals로서의 관점의 한계
